headline: DuPont exceeds own guidance, raises full-year outlook
summary_short: DuPont's Q2 net sales rose 4% y/y to $1,819M with GAAP EPS from continuing operations of $1.37 and Adjusted EPS up 48% to $1.88, and management raised full-year 2026 Operating EBITDA and Adjusted EPS guidance after exceeding its own second-quarter targets.
summary_long: Net sales of $1,819M rose 4% y/y (organic +4%), led by Healthcare & Water Technologies (+5%, organic +4%) and Diversified Industrials (+3%). Operating EBITDA (non-GAAP) rose 6% to $448M on organic growth and productivity; margin up 40bp to 24.6%. GAAP income from continuing operations rose to $191M ($1.37/share) from $24M, and Adjusted EPS rose 48% to $1.88 on higher segment earnings, lower net interest expense and a lower tax rate. Cash jumped to $1,740M q/q, mostly ~$1.2B of pre-tax Aramids divestiture proceeds; equity fell y/y to $13,769M after the Qnity spin-off and Aramids sale. DuPont raised FY2026 guidance to ~$1.76B Operating EBITDA and ~$7.24 Adjusted EPS, and plans a $250M Q3 buyback.

Adjusted EPS increased on higher segment earnings, lower net interest expense and a lower tax rate; GAAP EPS from continuing operations improved on the same segment-earnings and interest-expense dynamics.

Management cites mid-single-digit organic growth, margin expansion and free cash flow generation as underpinning execution; the CFO attributes the raised FY2026 Operating EBITDA (~$1.76B) and Adjusted EPS (~$7.24) guidance to second-quarter outperformance, with organic sales growth now expected slightly above 4%.
